task_name: Intrinsic Grade-Fiber Arithmetic, Ambient Realization, and the Correct TC Zeta

fiber_definition.tagged_fiber: F_K = {K} x Z = {(K, n) : n in Z}
fiber_definition.rationale: Separates abstract arithmetic referents from real-coordinate embedding to preserve distinction under potential realization collisions

ring_isomorphism.abstract_fiber_isomorphism: phi_K: Z -> (F_K, oplus_K, odot_K), n |-> (K, n) is a ring isomorphism
ring_isomorphism.realized_ring_isomorphism: widetilde_phi_K: Z -> (L_K, +, odot_K), n |-> n*tau^K is a ring isomorphism

prime_classification.fiber_prime: (K, p) is prime in (F_K, oplus_K, odot_K) iff p is an ordinary rational prime in Z
prime_classification.realized_prime: p*tau^K is the grade-K realization of rational prime p
prime_classification.intrinsic_factorization: (K, n) = prod_p^{odot_K} (K, p)^{odot_K v_p(n)} stays strictly at grade K
prime_classification.ambient_product_warning: Ordinary real product prod_p (p*tau^K)^{v_p(n)} moves to grade K*Omega(n), violating single-fiber arithmetic

canonical_transfer_maps.functoriality: T_{K <- K} = id, T_{M <- J} circ T_{J <- K} = T_{M <- K}

intrinsic_normalized_size.isometry_status: Transfer maps T_{J <- K} are exact isometries in intrinsic units

logarithmic_coordinates.ambient_log: u_{amb}(x) = log(x) = log(n) + K*log(tau) (translated by K*log(tau))

intrinsic_zeta.grade_invariance: Identically independent of K for all K in A_R

ambient_dirichlet_series.prefactor_interpretation: tau^{-Ks} is the dimensional unit realization factor, not intrinsic arithmetic

riemann_converter_interpretation.normalized_grade_coordinates: T_K^{int}(s, u) = T_0(s, u) (identical in native units)
riemann_converter_interpretation.ambient_coordinates: Evaluated at x = u*tau^K introduces log shift K*log(tau)

local_germ_reconciliation.local_germ_status: Modulus variation tau^{-(K-J)delta} is ambient unit covariance of quantity with scaling weight w = -(rho - 1/2)
local_germ_reconciliation.unit_normalized_germ: hat_c_K(rho) = tau^{K(rho - 1/2)} * c_{Xi_K}(rho) = c_xi(rho) is intrinsic and strictly grade-invariant

ambient_cross_grade_algebra.definition: (K, m) star (J, n) = (K + J, mn), realized as (m*tau^K)*(n*tau^J) = mn*tau^{K + J}
ambient_cross_grade_algebra.status_of_opposite_grade_cancel: tau^K * tau^{-K} = 1 belongs strictly to ambient cross-grade algebra, not intrinsic fiber arithmetic

full_algebraic_grade_group_algebra.elements: sum_{j=1}^r a_j [K_j] with a_j in Q_bar and K_j in A_R
full_algebraic_grade_group_algebra.realization_homomorphism: ev_tau: Q_bar[A_R] -> R, sum a_j [K_j] |-> sum a_j tau^{K_j}

rational_grades.proof: Common-denominator reduction to polynomials in transcendental tau^{1/N}

full_algebraic_grades.gelfond_schneider_bound: dim_Q S_tau <= 1 controls two-term relations, not arbitrary multi-term relations

rank_one_support_theorem.statement: If K_j = K_0 + q_j*alpha with q_j in Q and alpha notin S_tau, then {tau^{K_j}} are linearly independent over Q_bar

generic_base_control.statement: For any real base b > 0, (F_K, oplus_K, odot_{b, K}) is canonically isomorphic to Z via (m*b^K) odot_{b, K} (n*b^K) = mn*b^K
generic_base_control.conclusion: Intrinsic fiber arithmetic does not depend on tau or its transcendence

does_not_do: Does not alter Mobius or von Mangoldt arithmetic
does_do: Prevents ambient station collisions on rational subgrids
Guarantees injectivity of ev_tau on Q_bar[Q]
Constrains pairwise algebraic transfer factors via dim_Q S_tau <= 1

next_research_question: Does the non-trivial zero divisor of zeta force an authentic algebraic relation in ker(ev_tau) on Q_bar[A_R] through an explicit cross-grade arithmetic-spectral coupling functional?
